name: Greek Frittata with Spinach, Grape Tomatoes & Feta

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. Wash and halve tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, oregano, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
¾ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil and position rack about 10 cm from the top.
Add garlic and tomatoes to skillet. Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add spinach and stir to combine.

Spread out ingredients evenly in the skillet. Pour in egg mixture. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but the top is still runny, 6-8 minutes.
Sprinkle feta over top. Place skillet in the oven under the broiler until the top is set, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, cut frittata into wedges and place on a plate. Enjoy!
